timestamp_policy: Naive source clock times are interpreted as UTC for indexing only; the source does not identify timezone. This is not a claim about the actual geographic timezone.
selection: Three realKnownCause streams with unique monotonic timestamps and explicit regular sampling grids. No artificial NAB streams are included.

datasets.description: Aggregated NYC taxi passenger counts in 30-minute buckets.
datasets.preprocessing: Parse original numeric values with round-trip precision; reindex to documented cadence with NaN at absent timestamps; no interpolation, deduplication, sorting, outlier deletion, smoothing or anomaly removal.
